elastic.quality: Experimental host room-temperature values cited in text; not DFT Table4.

dixon1967.quality: Legacy full YAG set; conflicting literature, not exact Yb:YAG calibration.

johnson1967_incomplete.quality: Incomplete competing set. Do not fill p44 from Dixon silently.

convention: Delta B_ii=p11*e_ii+p12*(trace(e)-e_ii); Delta B_ij=2*p44*e_ij (i!=j). B is inverse relative dielectric tensor. e is mechanical elastic strain, not total strain.
warning: Do not combine total thermal strain photoelasticity with stress-free dn/dT: that double-counts free thermal dilation. Explicit rotation is required for non-[100] crystal frames.
